concept.definition: Export will include the most recent Provenance resource associated with each non-Provenance resource being returned, as identified by `Provenance.target`. Does not exclude Provenance resources that would otherwise be returned.
Export will include all available Provenance resources associated with each non-Provenance resource being returned, as identified by `Provenance.target`.
